brain_consensus.narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 trading venues fell to 1,116.8 million dollars over 24 hours, from 1,561.7 million dollars, and Bitget replaced Binance as the largest intake at 436.7 million dollars, up from 250.6 million. That figure is the change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the positive total means money is still arriving on exchanges, equal to 0.400 percent of the 279.0 billion dollars held there, down from 0.561 percent of the 278.6 billion dollars at the previous reading. Gate took in 216.3 million dollars and Bitstamp took in 182.0 million, while Binance intake fell to 123.2 million dollars from 495.7 million and Bitfinex flipped to a 12.5 million dollar outflow from a 216.2 million dollar intake.
